sam: Ran onboarding for orion-13B-int4 on staging. During a 4k->32k longctx sweep theres a deterministic token misalignment that starts at 16384 — outputs shift by one token afterwards.

maria: Is the issue present on fp16? Can you paste repro?

sam: FP16 is clean. Repro: 
```bash
python longctx_runner.py --model orion-13B-int4 --quant int4n --max_ctx 32768 --prompt tests/repeat_alpha.txt --debug kv_base,rotary_map
```
Logs: 
```
DEBUG: kv_base=16382
DEBUG: kv_base=16383
DEBUG: kv_base=0   # unexpected wrap
```

jin: Looks like an index wrap in the int4 pack stride. The packing reshape does a group = token_pos // 8 then group % tile, maybe modulus applied too early.

olga: Try disabling compact_pack to confirm. If that stops it we have a packing vs reshape ordering bug.

sam: Confirmed: disabling compact_pack removes the wrap. FP16 + compact_pack fine; only int4 + compact_pack reproduces.

jin: I'll write a small unit test to exercise pack_tokens_for_kv() across boundary values (4095..16385) and assert monotonic kv_base. Will push patch if failing.

olga: Opened ENG-ML-9002 with logs, repro and suggested temporary knob runtime.kv_grain=4096 for affected clusters. Assigning to jin for patch + sam for verification.

deploy-bot: ENG-ML-9002 created by olga -> https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/ENG-ML-9002

maria: Add a regression eval: 500 gold long prompts, compute continuity_error_rate and attach to ticket.

sam: Will run eval and attach numbers. Short-term P1 for staging + note to ops for hotfix on dedicated pools with long-context workloads.

olga: Also add fuzz cases at boundaries (4095,4096,4097,8191,8192,8193,16383,16384,16385) to nightly longctx suite.

sam: Thanks all, will follow up when unit test lands. :thumbsup:
